name: Star Chapel — structural sections
prompt:
Create ONE clean detailed GAME ASSET REFERENCE SHEET, NOT Blender or a3Dmodel. Plain light ivory studio background, soft even light, full uncropped separate objects, readable thickness, precise non-melting forms. FULL IDs and names outside silhouettes, dimensions marked PROPOSED. Each cell independent illustration scale. No environment scenery, humans, extra unlabeled objects, watermark or whole-palace redesign. Use ONLY the single supplied source image for visible style/material/form authority; infer missing backs and assembly interfaces conservatively. Source illustration motifs are inspiration, not recovered measured geometry. Visible source facts: Cross-shaped miniature plan, steep indigo roofs and clustered Gothic spires, huge purple star-rose window above pointed portal; pale stone/gold tracery, narrow flanking lancets, cypress belt and raised stair plinth. Hidden layout inference: Axial arrival stair and forecourt lead through the pointed portal to a modest ceremonial nave; transept pockets become quiet viewing alcoves, perimeter path provides loop back to water bridge without blocking entrance. Preserve dominant rose window rather than covering facade with planting. Preserve this local design. Exactly4 large cells, large three-quarter view for each module plus small front, top and side/contact/section diagram consistent with same geometry. Real open doors/arches/windows must show empty space; no opaque filling where an opening is requested. Continuous unobstructed planar joining ends, separate shells from optional decor, no fused unrelated objects. Hollow roof/room sections show the interior underside and wall thickness. Keep source silhouette, not generic boxes. Title "B03-STRUCT-001 — Star Chapel — structural sections". Footer "Proposed construction / source-compatible references / mesh joins and views unverified".

Purpose/gap: Need source-matched buttress/window wall, porch threshold/stair return and roof ridge/corner joins; source wheel, lancet, gold star and purple glass already exist. Cypress/cream flowers and small birds/butterflies selected; interior depth is proposed. Provide missing isolated hosts and join views.

B03-STRUCT-001-S01 — Buttressed lancet wall. Dimensions W,D,H [8, 6, 12]m proposed. One isolated buttressed lancet wall matching the supplied building, its roof/arch/wall silhouette and local materials. Show front and interior/rear/underside contact, not a complete building scene. Actual open column galleries and holes stay open. Extend hidden depth only enough to form a joinable section; no palace-wide plan or added unrelated tower.
